policy: No aggregate score is calculated. Metrics without sufficient, relevant evidence are NOT EVALUABLE.

synthetic_benchmark.title: Controlled synthetic anomaly benchmark

dataset.positive_definition: Known injected amount, velocity, merchant-rarity, or unusual-hour pattern; 2.5% labels flipped as controlled noise.

split.selection: validation Brier only; test used once after selection

limitations: Controlled generated distribution; not representative PayPal/customer data.
Does not establish real-world detection, calibration, or fraud performance.
Do not combine these values with reviewed-label or production scorecards.
